issues.claim: audit_md: 'Archives show the old site's facials, skin care and hot-stone massage pages; the last working capture is February 2023'
issues.problem: Wrong by one year, and contradicted by the source the auditor cites. The Wayback capture dated 29 Feb 2024 (https://web.archive.org/web/20240229065606/https://www.huakangskincare.com/) is the full live business page ('Hua Kang Skin Care - Facial . Massage . Hot Stone . Skin Care: 732-253-7885; 118 Ryders Lane'), stamped 'FILE ARCHIVED ON 06:56:06 Feb 29, 2024'. The CDX list rows the auditor cites also show that 2024-02-29 record. So the site was still serving its real pages in February 2024, not February 2023, and the gap before the parking page is about two months, not fourteen.
issues.fix: Change to: 'the last working capture is February 2024 (29 February), and by 3 April 2024 the address served the parking redirect'. Keep the April 2024 statement, which is correct.

issues.claim: likely_cause.reasoning: 'every capture from 2023-04-03 onward is the parking lander'
issues.problem: Both the year and the fact are wrong. There is no 2023-04-03 capture. The 2023-10-30 and 2023-12-30 captures are 301s (status 301, no parking body), the 2024-02-29 capture is a revisit of the real page, and the parking page starts at 2024-04-03. This sentence also contradicts the same paragraph's own statement that Oct/Dec 2023 captures still show the real pages.
issues.fix: Rewrite as: 'the 2023-10-30 and 2023-12-30 captures are redirects whose pages still point their menu links at huakangskincare.chinesenj.net; the real page was still served on 2024-02-29; every capture from 2024-04-03 onward is the parking page.'

issues.claim: after_fix.evidence: 'Reviews on BestProsInTown praise flexible late hours and walk-in friendliness'
issues.problem: The late hours part is supported by a June 2023 review. 'Walk-in friendliness' is not: the word 'walk' appears nowhere on the BestProsInTown listing or on its reviews page when checked live; the reviews praise friendly, accommodating staff, prices and late Sunday hours.
issues.fix: Replace with 'reviews there praise friendly, accommodating staff, prices and late Sunday hours'. Do not claim walk-in service without a source.

issues.problem: The date is right but the label is not what rdap.org shows. RDAP reports an event 'last changed' 2026-03-13 for the domain record; that is a registry record change (it can be a status or nameserver edit), not evidence of a change to someone's GoDaddy account.
issues.fix: Say 'the domain record was last changed on 13 March 2026 (this does not tell us who changed it or whether it was an account change)'.

issues.claim: audit_md: 'with no online booking today' / after_fix: 'no online booking of any kind today'
issues.problem: 'Of any kind' is an absolute that the cited source does not establish. The Google profile (limited signed-out view) shows no booking action, but the SpaAndParlor listing carries a 'Book Service' button, so 'no online booking of any kind' cannot be proven from what was checked.
issues.fix: Soften to 'no way to book online from the Google profile today', which is what the screenshot evidence shows.

issues.claim: links_to_broken_domain entry for SpaAndParlor: 'address, phone, hours; no website link in the page content'
issues.problem: Address and hours (daily 10:00AM-7:00PM) are visible, and there is indeed no website link, but the phone number is not shown: the page displays 'Contact No: Show Number' and no number appears until a visitor clicks it. Note also that this listing's 7 PM closing time contradicts the 9 PM the audit repeats elsewhere.
issues.fix: Change to 'address and hours only; the phone sits behind a 'Show Number' control; no website link', and mention that third-party hours disagree (7 PM vs 9 PM) rather than presenting 9 PM as settled.

issues.problem: None of these files was present in the package I was given to verify, so the visual claims could not be checked against them (only against the live pages, which matched).
issues.fix: Attach the three screenshots to the delivery before the owner sees it, or drop the references.
